root_cause: Independent obligations can target the same workflow/file while both have terminal lease claims, and duplicate obligation checks alone cannot serialize distinct obligations.
fix: Use canonical admission to check true changed files against declared Change-Scope, serialize exact overlapping still-open TERMINAL_DELIVERY PRs by oldest active PR number, exempt retired predecessors, keep unrelated work parallel.
prevention_rule: One terminal writer per shared resource. Preserve native expected_head_sha, two-attempt bounded Recovery Supervisor, Required and CodeQL on new exact PR-head. This admission is not an atomic lock; no unverified promotion or speedup.

invariants: Different obligation IDs cannot both be admitted as current terminal writers on one exact shared workflow
Actual candidate GitHub changed filenames must be declared
Two bounded native CAS retries and fresh Required/CodeQL remain authoritative
Existing hourly Janitor/Brain only, no second scheduler
Measured speedup requires independent repeatable regressions and performance readback
